notes: MERGED 2026-10-03 from nh_coalitions.json + nh_orgs.json. Coalition agent: WebFetch worked for most sites; cleanenergynh.org/members, nhcaw.org home, nhacc and some others were fetched only via specific pages; a few fetches failed (permission/robots: Climate Action NH Facebook, newhampshirenetwork.org home, nhsea.org, nhcoastaladaptation.org). No work-around used. Candidates not found as real coalitions: 'Climate Action NH' (only a Facebook page seen, robots-blocked), NH Healthy Homes/Healthy Kids, NH Rivers Council (not checked as coalition), a NH Environmental Common Agenda equivalent or Environmental Lobby Day (none found), NH Youth Climate coalition (only a 2020 one-off town hall), Seacoast area climate partner coalition (Seacoast Climate Action NOW is a single volunteer nonprofit, not in this file). NHSEA is the former name of Clean Energy NH (same org), so it is one org, not a coalition. Clean Energy NH publishes ~100 mostly business members (all-members page) but is a trade association, so it is an org here with no member edges. Monadnock Sustainability Hub is treated as an org, not a coalition (lists 5 partners: Clean Energy NH, Sierra Club, Monadnock Food Co-op, Cheshire County Conservation District, Hannah Grimes Center; not added as members). Coalitions without member lists: NHACC (200+ town conservation commissions unlisted), LES work group (no roster). CPCNH: capped at 40 of ~51 listed member programs (3 counties + first 37 towns on the members page); omitted: Charlestown, Durham, Franconia, Hanover, Kensington, Lyme, New London, Peterborough, Rye, Sugar Hill, Walpole (the site also says 64 municipalities and 4 counties as of May 2025, so the list is not complete). CAW: omitted ~14 design/engineering firms and BeachGoods.com, plus unclear 'UNH Climate & Interior Climate Adaptation Center' and 'Seacoast Watershed Commission'. GSCCC: 150+ stakeholders, only transit, universities, state agencies and Eversource listed. NH Network: the About page lists 29 organizations (it says about 30); 'League of Conservation Voters' assumed to be NH LCV; WindowDressers is Maine-based; Carbon Cash-Back Coalition is itself a coalition (linked as nh_carbon_cash_back_coalition_c). The NH Network 5th summit was Sept 26 per its events page (a news story says Sept 28) and is past. Locations for most volunteer groups are state-capital placeholders (remote true or approx) since no address was published; websites left empty where not verified. Coalition last_activity for CAW left blank (2026 summit recap exists but date not read). CPCNH last_activity 2026-05-08 is the NH Energy Week 2026 end date. NH Healthy Climate Nov 18 event year assumed 2026 from the host's chronological list. | Org agent: Coalitions/edges left empty by design. WebFetch worked only for URLs that had surfaced in search results; sierraclub.org root, nhsea.org, nhlcv.org etc. were blocked, so Conservation NH (only a Facebook listing seen), NHSEA (location from directory listings only) and Mothers Out Front NH (national local-teams page lists no NH team, so omitted) are thin or absent. Kearsarge Climate Action Facebook page blocked by robots.txt, so omitted. Not researched: Plan NH, Granite Bridge opponents beyond 350NH pages, local energy committees, Dartmouth/UNH Sunrise hubs (no hub list found; one statewide Sunrise NH entry from Monadnock directory). Vital Communities is based in White River Junction VT, omitted. last_activity empty where no dated item seen; inactive flag only set where newest dated item was before 2025 (NH IPL events page newest 2023; SAPL page updated Jan 2024). Many empty-last_activity orgs (CCL chapters, Rights & Democracy, TNC, etc.) are likely active but undated in what I read. Third Act NH event years inferred (weekday matches 2026). 350NH events page lists many past 2026 events, omitted. GSOP Oct 2026 chapter meetings and non-climate events omitted. Sierra Club NH, CLF, Audubon HQ coordinates are town centre or street. Clean Energy NH, LCV NH, R&D NH, NH Youth Movement, Sunrise NH, Peace Action have no stated address so placed at Concord with remote true. CCL chapter ids use region names; CCL Seacoast national page says status 'In Progress'. NH IPL location Canterbury from Gudsy listing. | Lead: NH Healthcare Workers for Climate Action merged into nh_nh_healthy_climate (same website). Carbon Cash-Back Coalition listed as a NH Network member is a coalition, so it is mentioned in the NH Network description instead of an edge. Lead: Third Act NH event years were inferred from weekdays, so those events are verified:false; the LES conference is kept once, on the LES coalition, hosted by Clean Energy NH. Lead spot-check (2026-10-03): the NH Network About page now lists 32 names; added the 3 missing (Tea & Talks, NH Citizens for Progress, Save Forest Lake) with no details researched. Lead: CLF NH moved to its Concord office (27 N Main St, per clf.org NH page); Franklin Pierce entries moved to Rindge town centre (coords had pointed into MA).
